<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="id"><head><base target="_top"><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;700&family=Montserrat:wght@600;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--logo:url(data:image/png;base64,);--bg:#070d1c;--c:#0e1730;--ln:#1f2f55;--t:#e6edff;--m:#8fa3d1;--cy:#22d3ee;--gr:#34d399;--am:#fbbf24;--pk:#f472b6;--vi:#a78bfa;--er:#fb7185;--notch:#070d1c}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;color:var(--t);font-family:'Space Grotesk',system-ui,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);
 background-image:linear-gradient(#22d3ee0d 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,#22d3ee0d 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:28px 28px;min-height:100vh}
header{padding:14px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ln);background:#0a1226e6;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.brand h1{font-size:18px;margin:0}.brand small{color:var(--m);display:block;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:11px}
.steam{display:flex;gap:4px;margin-left:auto}.steam i{font-style:normal;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:7px;display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 13px 'JetBrains Mono',monospace;color:#04101f}
main{max-width:780px;margin:auto;padding:14px}
.card{background:var(--c);border:1px solid var(--ln);border-radius:14px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:14px;position:relative;box-shadow:0 8px 24px #0006}
.card:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:14px;right:14px;top:-1px;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--cy),var(--gr),var(--am),var(--pk),var(--vi))}
h3{margin:0 0 8px}.pr{color:var(--gr);font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:13px}
input,select,textarea,button,.btn{font:inherit;width:100%;padding:11px;margin:4px 0;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--ln);background:#0a1226;color:var(--t)}
button,.btn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--cy),var(--gr));color:#04101f;font-weight:700;border:0;cursor:pointer;display:block;text-align:center}
button.s,.btn.s{background:#16224a;color:var(--t);border:1px solid var(--ln)}
.row{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.row>*{flex:1;min-width:120px}
.stat{text-align:center;border:1px solid var(--ln);border-radius:12px;padding:10px}.stat b{font:700 30px 'JetBrains Mono',monospace;display:block;color:var(--cy)}
.stat:nth-child(2) b{color:var(--gr)}.stat:nth-child(3) b{color:var(--am)}.stat:nth-child(4) b{color:var(--pk)}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:14px}td,th{padding:7px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ln);text-align:left}th{color:var(--m);font-weight:500}
.ok{color:var(--gr);font-weight:700}.err{color:var(--er);font-weight:700}.hide{display:none!important}
.rd{border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;border:1px dashed var(--cy);min-height:48px}
.cm{font-size:13px;color:var(--am);margin:4px 0}
.led{display:flex;gap:6px}.led button{background:#16224a;color:var(--m);border:1px solid var(--ln);padding:10px 0}
.led button.on{background:var(--am);color:#1b1200;box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--am)}
.link{background:none;color:var(--m);border:0;text-decoration:underline;width:auto;font-weight:400;display:inline-block}
/* ===== TIKET (98 x 30 mm) ===== */
#pr2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,98mm);gap:10px;overflow-x:auto}
.et{width:98mm;height:30mm;display:flex;background:#ede6e1;color:#111;font-family:'Montserrat',Arial,sans-serif;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:2mm}
.lg{background:var(--logo) center/contain no-repeat}.et-l{width:25mm;background:#2176c7;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:1.5mm}.et-l img,.et-l .lg{width:21mm;height:25mm;object-fit:contain}
.et-m{flex:1;min-width:0;padding:1.8mm 2.2mm;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between}
.et-mini{display:flex;gap:1mm;align-items:center}.et-mini img{height:4.5mm}.et-mini i{font:900 2.4mm 'Montserrat';font-style:normal;width:4.5mm;height:4.5mm;border-radius:1mm;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff}
.et-t1{font:900 2.9mm/1 'Montserrat';white-space:nowrap}.et-t2{font:900 2.4mm/1 'Montserrat';white-space:nowrap}
.et-s{font:700 1.8mm/1.1 'Montserrat';color:#333}.et-n{font:800 2.1mm/1.1 'Montserrat'}.et-n .nm{display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}.et-n small{display:block;font:700 1.7mm 'Montserrat';color:#444;margin-top:.3mm}
.et-ch span{font:800 1.6mm 'Montserrat';border:.25mm solid #111;border-radius:3mm;padding:.5mm 1.6mm;margin-right:1mm;display:inline-block;white-space:nowrap}
.et-r{width:27mm;border-left:.35mm dashed #111;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative}
.et-r:before,.et-r:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-1.7mm;width:3.2mm;height:3.2mm;border-radius:50%;background:var(--notch)}
.et-r:before{top:-1.6mm}.et-r:after{bottom:-1.6mm}
.et-q img,.et-q canvas{width:21mm!important;height:21mm!important;display:block}
.et-no{font:700 1.9mm 'JetBrains Mono',monospace;margin-top:.8mm}
@media print{
 @page{size:A4;margin:6mm}
 *{-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact}
 :root{--notch:#fff}body{background:#fff!important}
 header,#app>*:not(#vAdmin),#vAdmin>*:not(#pv){display:none!important}
 #pv{display:block!important}#pr2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,98mm);gap:0;overflow:visible}
 .et{border-radius:0;outline:.2mm dotted #888;break-inside:avoid}
 body.one .et:not(.sel){display:none}}
</style>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/qrcodejs/1.0.0/qrcode.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html5-qrcode/2.3.8/html5-qrcode.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/xlsx/0.18.5/xlsx.full.min.js"></script>
</head><body>
<header><div class="brand">
 <div class="lg" style="width:34px;height:40px"></div>
 <div><h1>SMART EXPO ARDUINO 2026</h1><small>SMPN 65 BANDUNG · INFORMATIKA IX · <span id="who">pengunjung</span></small></div>
 <div class="steam"><i style="background:var(--gr)">S</i><i style="background:var(--cy)">T</i><i style="background:var(--am)">E</i><i style="background:var(--pk)">A</i><i style="background:var(--vi)">M</i></div></div></header>
<main id="app">
<div id="vPub">
 <div class="card"><div class="pr">&gt; stand.select()</div><h3>Kunjungi stand &amp; beri apresiasi</h3>
 <select id="kel"></select>
 <div class="pr" style="margin-top:8px">&gt; scan(tiket_undangan)</div>
 <div id="reader" class="rd"></div><div id="camMsg" class="cm"></div>
 <div class="row"><button onclick="pubScan.start()">Aktifkan kamera</button><button class="s" onclick="pubScan.flip()">Ganti kamera</button>
  <label class="btn s">Foto QR<input type="file" id="fPub" accept="image/*" capture="environment" hidden></label></div>
 <button class="link" onclick="openTab()">Kamera tidak berfungsi? Buka di tab baru</button>
 <input id="man" placeholder="Atau ketik nomor tiket, mis. EXPO-2026-0001" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace">
 <button class="s" onclick="proc($('man').value)">Verifikasi tiket</button></div>
 <div id="res" class="card hide"></div>
 <div style="text-align:center"><button class="link" onclick="show('vLogin')">Masuk guru / siswa peserta</button></div>
</div>
<div id="vLogin" class="card hide"><div class="pr">&gt; auth.login()</div><h3>Masuk guru / siswa peserta</h3>
 <input id="u" placeholder="Username"><input id="p" type="password" placeholder="PIN">
 <button onclick="doLogin()">Masuk</button><div id="lm" class="err"></div>
 <button class="link" onclick="show('vPub')">&larr; Kembali ke halaman pengunjung</button></div>

<div id="vAdmin" class="hide">
 <div class="card"><div class="row"><button onclick="tab('dash')">Dashboard</button><button onclick="tab('data')">Data</button><button onclick="tab('tiket')">Tiket</button><button onclick="tab('ci')">Check-in</button><button class="s" onclick="location.reload()">Keluar</button></div></div>
 <div id="tDash" class="card"></div>
 <div id="tTiket" class="hide">
  <div class="card"><h3>Terbitkan tiket</h3><div class="pr">nama, kategori, instansi (satu baris per orang)</div>
  <textarea id="bulk" rows="5" placeholder="Bapak Ahmad, Guru, SMPN 65 Bandung" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace"></textarea>
  <div class="row"><button onclick="addT()">Terbitkan</button><button class="s" onclick="window.print()">Cetak yang ditampilkan / simpan PDF</button></div>
  <p class="cm">Tanggal, lokasi, jam, dan logo diatur di Data &gt; Pengaturan. Logo: tempel tautan Google Drive (atau ID file) pada kunci logoId.</p></div>
  <div class="card"><select id="fk" onchange="renderT()"></select><table id="tt"></table></div></div>
 <div id="tCi" class="hide"><div class="card"><h3>Check-in pintu masuk</h3>
  <div id="rdr2" class="rd"></div><div id="camMsg2" class="cm"></div>
  <div class="row"><button onclick="ciScan.start()">Aktifkan kamera</button><button class="s" onclick="ciScan.flip()">Ganti kamera</button>
   <label class="btn s">Foto QR<input type="file" id="fCi" accept="image/*" capture="environment" hidden></label></div>
  <button class="link" onclick="openTab()">Kamera tidak berfungsi? Buka di tab baru</button>
  <input id="man2" placeholder="Nomor tiket / token" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace"><button class="s" onclick="ci($('man2').value)">Check-in</button>
  <div id="cires" style="margin-top:8px"></div></div></div>
 <div id="tData" class="hide">
  <div class="card"><div class="row" id="entTabs"></div><p class="cm" id="hint"></p></div>
  <div class="card"><div class="row"><input id="q" placeholder="Cari data..." oninput="drawTable()"><button onclick="openForm()">+ Tambah data</button></div>
   <div class="row"><button class="s" onclick="dlTpl('xlsx')">Template XLSX</button><button class="s" onclick="dlTpl('csv')">Template CSV</button><button class="s" onclick="dlData('xlsx')">Ekspor XLSX</button><button class="s" onclick="dlData('csv')">Ekspor CSV</button><button id="gBtn" class="s hide" onclick="seedGroups()">Buat 4 kelompok per kelas</button></div>
   <textarea id="tplbox" class="hide" rows="6" readonly onfocus="this.select()" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:12px"></textarea>
   <p class="cm" id="cnt"></p><div style="overflow-x:auto"><table id="dt"></table></div></div>
  <div class="card hide" id="frm"></div>
  <div class="card"><h3>Impor data</h3><div class="pr">&gt; import(CSV | XLSX)</div>
   <label class="btn s">Pilih file CSV / XLSX<input type="file" id="fImp" accept=".csv,.xlsx,.xls,.txt" hidden></label>
   <textarea id="paste" rows="3" placeholder="Atau tempel data dari Excel/Sheets (baris pertama = judul kolom)"></textarea>
   <button class="s" onclick="parsePaste()">Baca data tempelan</button><div id="imp"></div></div>
 </div>
 <div id="pv" class="hide"><div id="pr2"></div></div>
</div>
<div id="vSiswa" class="hide"><div class="card" id="sCard"></div><div class="card"><button class="s" onclick="location.reload()">Keluar</button></div></div>
<div id="fsx" class="hide"></div>
</main>
<script>
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);let S={},cur='',sk=[0,0,0,0,0];
/* Mode ganda: di dalam Apps Script memakai google.script.run; di hosting luar (kamera diizinkan) memakai API JSON ke Apps Script. */
const API_URL='PASTE_ALAMAT_EXEC_DI_SINI'; // hanya dipakai bila halaman ini di-hosting di luar Apps Script
const IN_GAS=!!(window.google&&google.script&&google.script.run);
const run=IN_GAS?(fn,...a)=>new Promise((ok,no)=>google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(ok).withFailureHandler(e=>{alert(e.message||e);no(e)})[fn](...a))
 :async(fn,...a)=>{try{if(!/^https:\/\//.test(API_URL))throw new Error('API_URL belum diisi di Index.html (tempel alamat /exec Web app).');
  const r=await fetch(API_URL,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'text/plain;charset=utf-8'},body:JSON.stringify({fn,args:a})});
  const j=await r.json();if(!j.ok)throw new Error(j.error);return j.result}catch(e){alert(e.message||e);throw e}};
const getLoc=cb=>IN_GAS?google.script.url.getLocation(cb):cb({parameter:Object.fromEntries(new URLSearchParams(location.search))});
const esc=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));

/* ---- pemindai: kamera + cadangan foto QR ---- */
let APP_URL='';
function camDiag(){
 const ua=navigator.userAgent;
 if(!window.isSecureContext||!navigator.mediaDevices||!navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia)
  return 'Akses kamera membutuhkan halaman HTTPS dan browser yang mendukung kamera. Buka URL Web App /exec di Chrome.';
 if(/FBAN|FBAV|Instagram|Line\/|MicroMessenger|; wv\)/i.test(ua))
  return 'Aplikasi dibuka dari browser dalam aplikasi lain. Salin alamat /exec lalu buka langsung di Google Chrome.';
 try{
  const p=document.permissionsPolicy||document.featurePolicy;
  if(p&&p.allowsFeature&&!p.allowsFeature('camera'))
   return 'Browser memblokir kamera pada konteks halaman ini. Pastikan URL /exec dibuka langsung di tab Chrome, bukan pratinjau atau halaman yang disematkan.';
 }catch(e){}
 return '';
}
async function cameraPermissionState(){
 try{
  if(!navigator.permissions||!navigator.permissions.query)return 'unknown';
  return (await navigator.permissions.query({name:'camera'})).state;
 }catch(e){return 'unknown'}
}
function openTab(){
 if(!APP_URL){alert('Alamat aplikasi belum tersedia. Muat ulang halaman lalu coba lagi.');return}
 const k=$('kel')&&$('kel').value;
 window.open(APP_URL+(k?'?kelompok='+encodeURIComponent(k):''),'_blank','noopener');
}
function cameraErrorMessage(e){
 const n=String((e&&e.name)||'');
 const m=String((e&&e.message)||e||'');
 if(/NotAllowed|PermissionDenied|SecurityError/i.test(n+' '+m))
  return 'Izin kamera ditolak atau diblokir. Klik ikon kamera/gembok di kiri alamat situs, ubah Kamera menjadi Izinkan, lalu muat ulang halaman. Pastikan kamera tidak diblokir pengaturan privasi laptop.';
 if(/NotFound|DevicesNotFound/i.test(n+' '+m))
  return 'Kamera tidak ditemukan. Pastikan webcam terpasang/aktif. Anda juga dapat memakai Foto QR atau mengetik nomor tiket.';
 if(/NotReadable|TrackStart|Could not start/i.test(n+' '+m))
  return 'Kamera sedang digunakan aplikasi lain atau tidak dapat dibuka. Tutup Zoom/Meet/aplikasi kamera lain, lalu coba lagi.';
 if(/Overconstrained|ConstraintNotSatisfied/i.test(n+' '+m))
  return 'Kamera tidak mendukung pilihan yang diminta. Coba pilih kamera lain atau gunakan Foto QR.';
 return 'Kamera gagal diaktifkan ('+(n||m||'kesalahan tidak diketahui')+'). Periksa izin kamera, lalu coba lagi.';
}
function mkScan(box,file,msg,cb){
 let inst=null,lc='',facing='environment',busy=false,starting=false;
 const note=t=>{$(msg).textContent=t};
 const stopTracks=stream=>{try{stream.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop())}catch(e){}};
 async function chooseCamera(){
  // Minta izin lebih dahulu agar nama perangkat kamera dapat dibaca oleh browser.
  const constraints=facing==='environment'
   ?{video:{facingMode:{ideal:'environment'}},audio:false}
   :{video:{facingMode:{ideal:'user'}},audio:false};
  let stream=null;
  try{
   stream=await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia(constraints);
   stopTracks(stream);
  }catch(e){
   if(stream)stopTracks(stream);
   throw e;
  }
  const devices=await navigator.mediaDevices.enumerateDevices();
  const cams=devices.filter(d=>d.kind==='videoinput');
  if(!cams.length)throw new Error('NotFoundError: Kamera tidak ditemukan.');
  if(cams.length===1)return cams[0].deviceId;
  const labels=cams.map(c=>c.label.toLowerCase());
  if(facing==='environment'){
   const i=labels.findIndex(x=>/back|rear|environment|belakang/.test(x));
   if(i>=0)return cams[i].deviceId;
  }else{
   const i=labels.findIndex(x=>/front|user|facetime|integrated|built.?in/.test(x));
   if(i>=0)return cams[i].deviceId;
  }
  // Pada laptop umumnya kamera pertama adalah webcam bawaan/default.
  return cams[0].deviceId;
 }
 async function cleanup(){
  if(!inst)return;
  try{if(inst.isScanning)await inst.stop()}catch(e){}
  try{inst.clear()}catch(e){}
  inst=null;
 }
 const api={
  async start(){
   if(starting||busy)return;
   if(inst&&inst.isScanning)return;
   starting=true;
   const d=camDiag();
   if(d){note(d);starting=false;return}
   const permission=await cameraPermissionState();
   if(permission==='denied'){
    note('Izin kamera untuk situs ini berstatus DIBLOKIR. Klik ikon pengaturan situs di kiri alamat /exec → Kamera → Izinkan, kemudian muat ulang halaman.');
    starting=false;return;
   }
   note('Meminta izin kamera…');
   try{
    const deviceId=await chooseCamera();
    inst=new Html5Qrcode(box,{verbose:false});
    const config={fps:10,qrbox:(vw,vh)=>{
     const side=Math.floor(Math.min(vw,vh,320)*0.78);
     return{width:side,height:side};
    },aspectRatio:1.0};
    await inst.start(deviceId,config,tx=>{
     if(!busy&&tx&&tx!==lc){lc=tx;busy=true;Promise.resolve(cb(tx)).then(()=>{busy=false},()=>{busy=false})}
    },()=>{});
    note('Kamera aktif. Arahkan QR Code ke dalam bingkai pemindaian.');
   }catch(e){
    await cleanup();
    note(cameraErrorMessage(e));
   }finally{starting=false}
  },
  async stop(){
   starting=false;
   await cleanup();
   busy=false;
  },
  async flip(){
   if(starting)return;
   facing=facing==='environment'?'user':'environment';
   lc='';
   await cleanup();
   await api.start();
  },
  reset(){lc='';busy=false}
 };
 $(file).addEventListener('change',async ev=>{
  const f=ev.target.files&&ev.target.files[0];
  if(!f)return;
  note('Membaca QR Code dari foto…');
  try{
   const reader=new Html5Qrcode('fsx');
   const result=await reader.scanFile(f,false);
   cb(result);
   note('QR Code berhasil dibaca dari foto.');
  }catch(e){
   note('QR tidak terbaca pada foto. Pastikan QR terlihat utuh, fokus, dan cukup terang.');
  }finally{ev.target.value=''}
 });
 return api;
}
const pubScan=mkScan('reader','fPub','camMsg',tx=>proc(tx));
const ciScan=mkScan('rdr2','fCi','camMsg2',tx=>ci(tx));

function show(id){['vPub','vLogin','vAdmin','vSiswa'].forEach(x=>$(x).classList.add('hide'));$(id).classList.remove('hide');
 if(id==='vPub')pubScan.start();else pubScan.stop()}
IN_GAS?run('appUrl').then(u=>APP_URL=u):(APP_URL=location.origin+location.pathname);
(async()=>{const k=await run('listKelompok');
 getLoc(l=>{const q=(l.parameter&&l.parameter.kelompok)||'';
  $('kel').innerHTML='<option value="">— Pilih kelompok yang dikunjungi —</option>'+k.map(x=>`<option ${x==q?'selected':''}>${esc(x)}</option>`).join('')});
 pubScan.start()})();

/* ---- pengunjung ---- */
async function proc(tx){tx=(tx||'').trim();if(!tx)return;if(!$('kel').value){alert('Pilih kelompok yang Anda kunjungi dahulu.');pubScan.reset();return}
 cur=tx;const r=await run('scanVisit',$('kel').value,tx),b=$('res');b.classList.remove('hide');
 const t=r.t?`<h3>${esc(r.t.nama)}</h3><p style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace">${r.t.noTiket} · ${esc(r.t.kategori)}</p>`:'';
 let h=t+`<p class="${r.ok&&!r.sudahDinilai?'ok':'err'}">${esc(r.msg)}</p>`;
 if(r.ok&&!r.sudahDinilai){sk=[0,0,0,0,0];h+=r.indikator.map((n,i)=>`<div style="margin:8px 0">${n}<div class="led">${[1,2,3,4,5].map(v=>`<button onclick="rate(${i},${v},this)">${v}</button>`).join('')}</div></div>`).join('')+
 `<textarea id="kom" rows="2" placeholder="Komentar / apresiasi (opsional)"></textarea><select id="by"><option value="pengunjung">Diisi pengunjung sendiri</option><option value="siswa">Diisi siswa sesuai jawaban pengunjung</option></select><button onclick="send()">Kirim penilaian</button>`}
 b.innerHTML=h;b.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})}
function rate(i,v,el){sk[i]=v;[...el.parentNode.children].forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('on'));el.classList.add('on')}
async function send(){const r=await run('submitScore',$('kel').value,cur,sk,$('kom').value,$('by').value);
 $('res').innerHTML=`<p class="${r.ok?'ok':'err'}">${esc(r.msg)}</p>`;pubScan.reset();$('man').value=''}

/* ---- login ---- */
async function doLogin(){const r=await run('login',$('u').value.trim(),$('p').value.trim());
 if(!r.ok){$('lm').textContent=r.msg;return}S=r;$('who').textContent=r.nama;
 if(r.role==='admin'){show('vAdmin');tab('dash')}
 else if(r.role==='siswa'){show('vSiswa');const g=await run('myGroup',r.sid);
  $('sCard').innerHTML=`<div class="pr">&gt; kelompok.${esc(g.kelompok)}</div><h3>Halo, ${esc(r.nama)}</h3><div class="row"><div class="stat"><b>${g.kunjungan}</b>Kunjungan</div><div class="stat"><b>${g.penilaian}</b>Penilaian</div><div class="stat"><b>${g.rata2}</b>Rata-rata</div></div>
  <p class="pr">Apresiasi terbaru</p>${g.komentar.map(k=>`<p>“${esc(k)}”</p>`).join('')||'<p>Belum ada komentar.</p>'}
  <p style="color:var(--m)">QR stand: tambahkan <span class="pr">?kelompok=${esc(g.kelompok)}</span> di akhir alamat aplikasi.</p>`}
 else $('lm').textContent='Peran tidak dikenali.'}

/* ---- guru ---- */
function tab(n){['tDash','tTiket','tCi','tData','pv'].forEach(x=>$(x).classList.add('hide'));ciScan.stop();
 if(n==='dash')loadDash();else if(n==='data')loadData();else if(n==='tiket')loadT();else{$('tCi').classList.remove('hide');ciScan.start()}}
async function loadDash(){$('tDash').classList.remove('hide');const d=await run('dashboard',S.sid);
 $('tDash').innerHTML=`<div class="pr">&gt; monitoring.live()</div><div class="row" style="margin:8px 0"><div class="stat"><b>${d.undangan}</b>Undangan</div><div class="stat"><b>${d.hadir}</b>Hadir</div><div class="stat"><b>${d.kunjungan}</b>Kunjungan</div><div class="stat"><b>${d.penilaian}</b>Penilaian</div></div>
 <table><tr><th>Kelompok</th><th>Kunjungan</th><th>Penilaian</th><th>Rata-rata</th></tr>${d.rekap.map(r=>`<tr><td>${esc(r.kelompok)}</td><td>${r.kunjungan}</td><td>${r.penilaian}</td><td>${r.rata2}</td></tr>`).join('')}</table>`}
const dr=(id,w)=>`https://drive.google.com/thumbnail?id=${encodeURIComponent(id)}&sz=w${w}`;
function ticketEl(t,c){const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='et';d.dataset.no=t.noTiket;
 const L=c.logoData?`<img src="${c.logoData}" alt="">`:`<div class="lg"></div>`;
 const mini=(c.miniData||[]).map(d=>`<img src="${d}" alt="">`).join('')||
  [['S','#10b981'],['T','#0ea5e9'],['E','#f59e0b'],['A','#ec4899'],['M','#8b5cf6']].map(x=>`<i style="background:${x[1]}">${x[0]}</i>`).join('');
 d.innerHTML=`<div class="et-l">${L}</div><div class="et-m"><div class="et-mini">${mini}</div><div><div class="et-t1">EXPO PROYEK ARDUINO</div><div class="et-t2">SMP NEGERI 65 BANDUNG</div></div><div class="et-n"><span class="nm">${esc(t.nama)}</span><small>${esc(t.kategori)}${t.instansi?' · '+esc(t.instansi):''}</small></div><div class="et-ch"><span>${esc(c.tanggal)}</span><span>${esc(c.lokasi)}</span><span>${esc(c.jam)}</span></div></div><div class="et-r"><div class="et-q"></div><div class="et-no">${t.noTiket}</div></div>`;
 new QRCode(d.querySelector('.et-q'),{text:t.token,width:160,height:160,correctLevel:QRCode.CorrectLevel.M});return d}
let TK=[],CFG={};
async function loadT(){$('tTiket').classList.remove('hide');const keep=$('fk').value;
 let l,c;try{[l,c]=await Promise.all([run('listTickets',S.sid),run('ticketConfig',S.sid)])}catch(e){return}
 if(!Array.isArray(l)||!c){$('tt').innerHTML='<tr><td class="err">Server tidak mengembalikan data tiket. Deploy ulang Web app (Manage deployments > Edit > New version) lalu muat ulang halaman.</td></tr>';return}
 TK=l;CFG=c;const gs=[...new Set(l.map(t=>t.kategori+' · '+t.instansi))].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,undefined,{numeric:true}));
 $('fk').innerHTML=`<option value="">— Pilih kelompok tiket yang ditampilkan (${l.length} tiket) —</option><option value="*">Semua tiket (lambat bila banyak)</option>`+gs.map(g=>`<option value="${esc(g)}" ${g===keep?'selected':''}>${esc(g)} (${l.filter(t=>t.kategori+' · '+t.instansi===g).length})</option>`).join('');
 if(keep==='*')$('fk').value='*';renderT()}
function renderT(){const v=$('fk').value,l=v==='*'?TK:v===''?[]:TK.filter(t=>t.kategori+' · '+t.instansi===v);
 if(!TK.length){$('tt').innerHTML='<tr><td>Belum ada tiket. Tambahkan lewat menu Data &gt; Undangan.</td></tr>';$('pr2').innerHTML='';return}
 if(!l.length){$('tt').innerHTML='<tr><td>Pilih kelompok tiket di atas untuk menampilkan dan mencetak.</td></tr>';$('pr2').innerHTML='';$('pv').classList.add('hide');return}
 $('tt').innerHTML='<tr><th>No</th><th>Nama</th><th>Kategori</th><th>Status</th><th></th></tr>'+l.map(t=>`<tr><td style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace">${t.noTiket}</td><td>${esc(t.nama)}</td><td>${esc(t.kategori)} ${esc(t.instansi)}</td><td>${t.status}</td><td style="white-space:nowrap"><button class="s" style="display:inline-block;width:auto" onclick="printOne('${t.noTiket}')">Cetak</button> <button class="s" style="display:inline-block;width:auto" onclick="tog('${t.noTiket}','${t.status==='Dinonaktifkan'?'Belum digunakan':'Dinonaktifkan'}')">${t.status==='Dinonaktifkan'?'Aktifkan':'Nonaktifkan'}</button></td></tr>`).join('');
 $('pv').classList.remove('hide');const box=$('pr2');box.innerHTML='';let i=0;
 (function chunk(){const e=Math.min(i+25,l.length);for(;i<e;i++)box.appendChild(ticketEl(l[i],CFG));if(i<l.length)setTimeout(chunk,0)})()}
function printOne(no){const e=document.querySelector(`.et[data-no="${no}"]`);if(!e)return;e.classList.add('sel');document.body.classList.add('one');
 setTimeout(()=>{window.print();setTimeout(()=>{e.classList.remove('sel');document.body.classList.remove('one')},500)},100)}
async function tog(n,s){await run('setTicketStatus',S.sid,n,s);loadT()}
async function addT(){const l=$('bulk').value.split('\n').map(x=>x.split(',').map(y=>y.trim())).filter(x=>x[0]).map(x=>({nama:x[0],kategori:x[1]||'Umum',instansi:x[2]||''}));
 if(!l.length)return;await run('addTickets',S.sid,l);$('bulk').value='';loadT()}
async function ci(tx){if(!tx)return;const r=await run('checkin',S.sid,tx.trim());
 $('cires').innerHTML=(r.t?`<b>${esc(r.t.nama)}</b> · ${r.t.noTiket} · ${esc(r.t.kategori)}<br>`:'')+`<span class="${r.ok?'ok':'err'}">${esc(r.msg)}</span>`;$('man2').value='';ciScan.reset()}

/* ---- CRUD, template, impor ---- */
let META={},EN='USERS',ROWS=[],IMP=[];
const OPT={role:['siswa','admin'],status:['Belum digunakan','Sudah check-in','Dinonaktifkan']};
async function loadData(){$('tData').classList.remove('hide');if(!META.USERS)META=await run('crudMeta',S.sid);
 $('entTabs').innerHTML=Object.keys(META).map(k=>`<button class="${k===EN?'':'s'}" onclick="setEn('${k}')">${META[k].label}</button>`).join('');
 $('hint').textContent=META[EN].hint;$('gBtn').classList.toggle('hide',EN!=='GROUPS');$('frm').classList.add('hide');$('imp').innerHTML='';$('tplbox').classList.add('hide');$('q').value='';
 ROWS=await run('crudList',S.sid,EN);drawTable()}
function setEn(k){EN=k;loadData()}
async function seedGroups(){const k=prompt('Kelas yang dibuatkan kelompok (pisahkan koma):','9.1,9.2,9.3,9.4');if(!k)return;
 const n=parseInt(prompt('Jumlah kelompok per kelas:','4'),10);if(!(n>0&&n<=10))return;const rows=[];
 k.split(',').map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean).forEach(kl=>{for(let i=1;i<=n;i++)rows.push({kelompok:kl+'-K'+i,kelas:kl})});
 const r=await run('crudImport',S.sid,'GROUPS',rows,'new');alert('Dibuat '+r.tambah+' kelompok'+(r.jumlahGalat?'; '+r.jumlahGalat+' dilewati karena sudah ada.':'.'));loadData()}
function drawTable(){const m=META[EN],q=$('q').value.toLowerCase();
 const rs=ROWS.filter(r=>!q||m.cols.some(c=>String(r[c]).toLowerCase().includes(q)));
 $('dt').innerHTML=`<tr>${m.cols.map(c=>`<th>${c}</th>`).join('')}<th></th></tr>`+rs.slice(0,300).map(r=>`<tr>${m.cols.map(c=>`<td>${esc(r[c])}</td>`).join('')}<td style="white-space:nowrap"><button class="s" style="display:inline-block;width:auto" data-k="${esc(r[m.key])}" onclick="openForm(this.dataset.k)">Ubah</button> <button class="s" style="display:inline-block;width:auto" data-k="${esc(r[m.key])}" onclick="delRec(this.dataset.k)">Hapus</button></td></tr>`).join('');
 $('cnt').textContent=rs.length+' data'+(rs.length>300?' (300 pertama ditampilkan)':'')}
function openForm(key){const m=META[EN],isNew=key===undefined,rec=isNew?{}:(ROWS.find(r=>String(r[m.key])===key)||{});const f=$('frm');
 f.innerHTML=`<h3>${isNew?'Tambah':'Ubah'} ${m.label}</h3>`+m.cols.filter(c=>!(EN==='TICKETS'&&c==='noTiket'&&isNew)).map(c=>{const val=rec[c]??'',ro=!isNew&&c===m.key;
  return `<label class="pr">${c}${m.req.includes(c)?' *':''}</label>`+(OPT[c]?`<select id="f_${c}">${OPT[c].map(o=>`<option ${o===val?'selected':''}>${o}</option>`).join('')}</select>`:`<input id="f_${c}" value="${esc(val)}" ${ro?'readonly':''}>`)}).join('')+
  `<div class="row"><button onclick="saveRec(${isNew})">Simpan</button><button class="s" onclick="$('frm').classList.add('hide')">Batal</button></div><div id="fm" class="err"></div>`;
 f.classList.remove('hide');f.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})}
async function saveRec(isNew){const rec={};META[EN].cols.forEach(c=>{const el=$('f_'+c);if(el)rec[c]=el.value});
 const r=await run('crudSave',S.sid,EN,rec,isNew);if(!r.ok){$('fm').textContent=r.msg;return}loadData()}
async function delRec(k){if(!confirm('Hapus data "'+k+'"? Tindakan ini tidak dapat dibatalkan.'))return;
 const r=await run('crudDelete',S.sid,EN,k);if(!r.ok)alert(r.msg);else loadData()}

function toCSV(aoa){return aoa.map(r=>r.map(x=>{x=String(x??'');return /[",\n\r;\t]/.test(x)?'"'+x.replace(/"/g,'""')+'"':x}).join(',')).join('\r\n')}
function parseCSV(t){t=t.replace(/^\ufeff/,'');const l1=t.split(/\r?\n/)[0]||'';const d=l1.includes('\t')?'\t':((l1.match(/;/g)||[]).length>(l1.match(/,/g)||[]).length?';':',');
 const rows=[];let row=[],cur='',q=false;for(let i=0;i<t.length;i++){const ch=t[i];
  if(q){if(ch==='"'){if(t[i+1]==='"'){cur+='"';i++}else q=false}else cur+=ch}
  else if(ch==='"')q=true;else if(ch===d){row.push(cur);cur=''}
  else if(ch==='\n'||ch==='\r'){if(ch==='\r'&&t[i+1]==='\n')i++;row.push(cur);rows.push(row);row=[];cur=''}else cur+=ch}
 if(cur!==''||row.length){row.push(cur);rows.push(row)}
 const h=(rows.shift()||[]);return rows.filter(r=>r.some(x=>String(x).trim()!=='')).map(r=>Object.fromEntries(h.map((k,i)=>[k,r[i]??''])))}
function dlBlob(name,blob){const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download=name;document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();setTimeout(()=>{URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);a.remove()},1500)}
function saveAOA(aoa,name,fmt){const csv=toCSV(aoa);
 try{if(fmt==='xlsx'){const ws=XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(aoa),wb=XLSX.utils.book_new();XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb,ws,'DATA');
   dlBlob(name+'.xlsx',new Blob([XLSX.write(wb,{type:'array',bookType:'xlsx'})],{type:'application/octet-stream'}))}
  else dlBlob(name+'.csv',new Blob(['\ufeff'+csv],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'}))}catch(e){}
 const b=$('tplbox');b.value=csv;b.classList.remove('hide')} // cadangan: salin teks bila unduhan diblokir
function dlTpl(f){const m=META[EN];saveAOA([m.tpl,...m.sample],'template_'+EN.toLowerCase(),f)}
function dlData(f){const m=META[EN];saveAOA([m.cols,...ROWS.map(r=>m.cols.map(c=>r[c]))],'data_'+EN.toLowerCase(),f)}

const norm=s=>String(s).trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[\s_-]+/g,'');
function prev(objs){const m=META[EN],col={};m.cols.forEach(c=>col[norm(c)]=c);
 IMP=objs.map(o=>{const r={};Object.keys(o).forEach(k=>{const c=col[norm(k)];if(c)r[c]=String(o[k]??'').trim()});return r}).filter(r=>Object.values(r).some(v=>v!==''));
 const have=new Set(IMP.flatMap(r=>Object.keys(r))),miss=(EN==='TICKETS'?['nama']:m.req).filter(c=>!have.has(c));
 if(!IMP.length||miss.length){$('imp').innerHTML=`<p class="err">${!IMP.length?'Tidak ada baris data yang terbaca.':'Kolom wajib tidak ditemukan: '+miss.join(', ')+'. Gunakan template.'}</p>`;IMP=[];return}
 const cs=[...have];$('imp').innerHTML=`<p class="ok">${IMP.length} baris terbaca. Pratinjau 5 baris pertama:</p><div style="overflow-x:auto"><table><tr>${cs.map(c=>`<th>${c}</th>`).join('')}</tr>${IMP.slice(0,5).map(r=>`<tr>${cs.map(c=>`<td>${esc(r[c])}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`).join('')}</table></div>
 <select id="mode"><option value="new">Tambah baru saja (tolak yang sudah ada)</option><option value="upsert">Tambah &amp; perbarui yang sudah ada</option></select><button onclick="doImport()">Impor ${IMP.length} baris</button><div id="impr"></div>`}
async function doImport(){const r=await run('crudImport',S.sid,EN,IMP,$('mode').value);
 $('impr').innerHTML=`<p class="${r.ok?'ok':'err'}">Ditambah ${r.tambah}, diperbarui ${r.perbarui}, galat ${r.jumlahGalat||0}.</p>`+(r.galat&&r.galat.length?`<table>${r.galat.map(g=>`<tr><td>Baris ${g.baris}</td><td>${esc(g.pesan)}</td></tr>`).join('')}</table>`:'');
 if(r.tambah||r.perbarui){ROWS=await run('crudList',S.sid,EN);drawTable()}}
$('fImp').addEventListener('change',async ev=>{const f=ev.target.files[0];if(!f)return;
 try{if(/\.(xlsx|xls)$/i.test(f.name)){const wb=XLSX.read(new Uint8Array(await f.arrayBuffer()),{type:'array'});prev(XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(wb.Sheets[wb.SheetNames[0]],{defval:'',raw:false}))}
  else prev(parseCSV(await f.text()))}catch(e){$('imp').innerHTML='<p class="err">File tidak terbaca. Gunakan CSV/XLSX sesuai template.</p>'}ev.target.value=''});
function parsePaste(){const t=$('paste').value.trim();if(t)prev(parseCSV(t))}
</script></body></html>
